title: 1963 F8 Atlas missile tracked by a tagalong

tellings.quote: And in 1963, we have another example of an F8 Atlas missile being tracked by this sort of tag along. And it's even in the report.

plain: In 1963 an Atlas F missile, a US intercontinental missile, is said to have been followed during flight from Vandenberg Air Force Base in California by an unknown object riding alongside it, a "tagalong." Michels tells this himself and says "it's even in the report," without naming the report. If true, something unknown was taking an interest in American nuclear missiles.
